panels.description: The OS distribution of running containers sourced from /etc/os-release, as reported by the node exporter. Containers with no /etc/os-release (e.g. scratch images) are excluded.
panels.title: OS Distribution

panels.description: The percentage of running containers whose /etc/os-release identifies the OS as Chainguard versus any other OS.

targets.expr:
count by (value) (
    label_replace(
      container_image_node_container_info{exported_namespace=~"$namespace", os_id=~"chainguard|wolfi"},
      "value", "Chainguard / Wolfi", "", ""
    )
  or
    label_replace(
      container_image_node_container_info{exported_namespace=~"$namespace", os_id!~"chainguard|wolfi"},
      "value", "Non-Chainguard", "", ""
    )
)

panels.title: Chainguard vs Non-Chainguard

panels.description: Containers that are not running Chainguard images or images based on Chainguard images.

targets.expr: max(container_image_node_container_info{exported_namespace=~"$namespace",os_id!~"wolfi|chainguard"}) by (exported_namespace,exported_pod,exported_container,image)

panels.title: Non-Chainguard Containers
